webhooks.detail: Per-job async webhooks (async.webhook on *_async endpoints), Studio webhook config, POST /configure_webhook; Svix-based setup recipe.

evidence.quote: Configure webhooks to receive notifications when jobs complete.

sandbox.detail: No free tier, trial, or test mode found on studio-account, FAQ, or llms.txt pages. Plans listed: Standard, Growth, Enterprise. Free credits may exist on pricing page, not verified.

evidence.quote: Monthly and yearly plans are available.

rate_limits.summary: 1,000 req/s per API key on all endpoints (429 over limit); GET /job/{id} 300 req/s; plus per-plan page-concurrency caps

evidence.quote: Edge rate limits apply to every request at the ingress and protect against accidental floods.
